title: Snowboard Length by Height and Weight
method: Only for missing model charts: linear interpolation between listed heights, round outward; unknown weight uses union of all bands; intersect with actual listed lengths. No extrapolation or automatic style offsets.
limits: 152–183cm generic adult starting point, not a per-model range. Children and explicitly identified special shapes excluded; known official mismatch is never overridden.

casi.finding: The inspected section prioritizes rider weight and manufacturer ranges; it does not establish a universal numerical height-to-length chart.

japaneseBrands.status: No verifiable current per-model rider-weight range found in inspected official sources
japaneseBrands.excludedMisreads: YONEX sleeve-size chart refers to protective sleeves, not rider sizing. FT/SW and product shipping weight are not rider weight.
